name: tabkyra-demo-video
description: The Tabkyra demo video (media/demo.mp4), composed in Remotion from a real recorded run

scripts.render: remotion render Demo out/demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 && remotion still Poster out/demo-poster.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=90
scripts.render:hero: remotion render Hero out/hero.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k && remotion render HeroVertical out/hero-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k && remotion still HeroPoster out/hero-poster.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=90
scripts.publish-hero: cp out/hero.mp4 ../hero.mp4 && cp out/hero-vertical.mp4 ../hero-vertical.mp4 && cp out/hero-poster.jpg ../hero-poster.jpg
scripts.render:agents: remotion render Agents out/agents.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k && remotion render AgentsVertical out/agents-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k && remotion still AgentsPoster out/agents-poster.jpg --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=90
scripts.publish-agents: cp out/agents.mp4 ../agents.mp4 && cp out/agents-vertical.mp4 ../agents-vertical.mp4 && cp out/agents-poster.jpg ../agents-poster.jpg
